summary: Three listed churches in the Shepherd and Saints Family. The Family Mass Schedule box, Family Confessions and the Eucharistic Adoration & Devotions box on p2 are the same in all five bulletins read. Includes St. Gregory's 24/7 Adoration (recorded 12:00 AM-11:59 PM daily), the St. Pius X Adoration Chapel, First Friday Adoration and the fourth-Monday Healing Mass with Confession at St. Pius X. No open questions.
